The '''Intran system''' was an uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had a secret [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base<ref name="FBS" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Intran]]<ref name="CSWE" /> with one full [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="FBS" />
